customer_id.meaning: Primary id of the homeowner's customer profile (content hash).

name.meaning: Account holder's full name exactly as it appears on the profile; not a verification credential.

phone_number.meaning: Primary phone number on file for the account holder.

email.meaning: Email address on file for the account holder, lower case.

service_address.meaning: Street line of the single residential service address the profile covers (house number and street, e.g. 4417 Kenny Rd).

service_zip.meaning: ZIP code of the service address.

account_pin.meaning: Four-digit account PIN the homeowner chose when the profile was opened.

customer_since.meaning: Date the customer profile was opened.

discount_program.meaning: Courtesy discount program the customer was enrolled in after documents were checked at profile opening; none when not enrolled.

equipment_id.meaning: Primary id of one piece of heating, cooling or water-heating equipment registered at the customer's service address.

brand.meaning: Manufacturer brand printed on the unit's data plate (e.g. Carrier, Trane, Lennox, Rheem, Goodman).

model_number.meaning: Model number from the unit's data plate.

serial_number.meaning: Serial number from the unit's data plate; the manufacturer's warranty registration key.

install_date.meaning: Date the unit was installed at the address (from the installer's records or the data-plate manufacture date when the installer is unknown); equipment age is counted from this date.

installed_by_harbison.meaning: Whether Harbison crews installed this unit.

refrigerant_type.meaning: Refrigerant the unit is charged with; none for heating-only and water-heating equipment.

nominal_tons.format: tons, 1 decimal place (e.g. 3.5); 0.0 for heating-only and water-heating equipment
nominal_tons.meaning: Nominal cooling capacity of the unit.

equipment_status.meaning: Whether the unit is still operating at the address; replaced once a new system installed by Harbison has superseded it.

agreement_id.meaning: Primary id of one Comfort Club maintenance agreement.

variant_name.meaning: Comfort Club tier held, as the official tier name.

status.meaning: Lifecycle state of the agreement (basis in the plan charter lifecycle).

enrolled_date.meaning: Date the agreement was first enrolled; never changes on renewal.

term_start.meaning: First day of the current 12-month agreement term.

term_end.meaning: Last day of the current agreement term (inclusive).

billing_frequency.meaning: How dues are billed for the current term: once per term in advance, or monthly in advance.

systems_covered.meaning: Number of heating/cooling systems at the address enrolled under the agreement.

auto_renew.meaning: Whether the agreement renews automatically at term end.

enrollment_channel.meaning: Channel through which the agreement was originally enrolled.

consecutive_terms.meaning: Number of consecutive terms held without a break, counting the current term.

locked_annual_rate.meaning: Annual first-system dues rate locked for renewal under the price-lock entitlement; 0.00 when the tier carries no price lock.

dues_balance.meaning: Dues owed on the agreement: positive means the member owes, negative means Harbison owes the member; identically the sum of the dues_receivable account deltas.

visits_remaining.meaning: Maintenance visits still available in the current term; identically the sum of the visit_allowance account deltas.

repair_coverage_remaining.meaning: Covered-repair benefit still available in the current term; identically the sum of the repair_coverage account deltas; 0.00 for tiers without covered repairs.

cancelled_date.meaning: Date the agreement became cancelled; empty while not cancelled.

billing_entry_id.meaning: Primary id of one dues ledger entry.

agreement_id.meaning: Agreement the entry is posted to (foreign key -> plan_agreements).

event_type.meaning: Event family of the entry, verbatim from the plan charter.

line_type.meaning: What the entry is: a dues or fee charge, a payment, a credit, or the payout of a credit balance.

billing_period.meaning: Billing month the entry belongs to: the dues month for monthly dues, the month the term starts for annual and renewal dues, the month posted for fees, payments, credits and payouts.

amount.meaning: Entry amount; the direction (owed or settled) comes from the event family, never from a sign.

posted_date.meaning: Date the entry was posted to the agreement.

payment_method.meaning: How a payment was made or a payout returned; empty on charges and credits.

payment_reference.meaning: Processor confirmation number of a payment or payout, as printed on the receipt; empty on charges and credits.

source_entry_id.meaning: The specific earlier entry this one offsets or settles (the late fee a waiver reverses, the credit a payout pays out); empty when the entry stands alone.

ticket_id.meaning: Service ticket a response-guarantee credit is earned on (foreign key -> service_tickets); empty otherwise.

service_entry_id.meaning: Primary id of one maintenance-visit or covered-repair entry.

agreement_id.meaning: Agreement the entry belongs to (foreign key -> plan_agreements).

event_type.meaning: Event family of the entry, verbatim from the plan charter.

entry_reason.meaning: Why the visit allowance or repair coverage moved; term_expiry and agreement_closed mark unused allowance or coverage removed at term end or at closure.

term_start.meaning: Start date of the agreement term the entry belongs to.

equipment_id.meaning: Equipment unit the visit or grant concerns (foreign key -> equipment); empty for whole-home visits and coverage entries.

season.meaning: Which maintenance visit: the cooling-season tune-up, the heating-season tune-up, or the whole-home visit; empty on coverage entries and on grants.

visits.meaning: Number of visits granted or used by the entry; 0 on coverage entries.

amount.meaning: Covered-repair benefit granted or drawn; 0.00 on visit entries.

entry_date.meaning: Date of the visit (for visit entries) or of posting (for grants and draws).

ticket_id.meaning: Service ticket whose repair a coverage draw pays (foreign key -> service_tickets); empty otherwise.

source_line_id.meaning: The specific service invoice line a coverage draw pays (foreign key -> service_lines); empty otherwise.

plan_request_id.meaning: Primary id of a member-confirmed agreement change request.

agreement_id.meaning: Agreement the request concerns (foreign key -> plan_agreements).

target_variant_name.meaning: Tier the agreement moves to at renewal for a downgrade request; empty for cancellations.

request_status.meaning: Where the request stands: awaiting the member's own confirmation, confirmed by the member, or withdrawn.

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
created_at.meaning: Moment the member's request was received; the notice date for cancellation timing.

contract_id.meaning: Primary id of one Harbison protection contract on a piece of equipment.

paired_equipment_id.meaning: Second unit of a matched system (the furnace or air handler paired with the outdoor unit) when the contract covers a matched system; empty for a single-unit contract.

install_id.meaning: Harbison installation project that installed the covered equipment (foreign key -> install_projects); empty for equipment Harbison did not install.

variant_name.meaning: Protection tier held, as the official tier name.

status.meaning: Lifecycle state of the contract (basis in the warranty charter lifecycle).

purchase_date.meaning: Date the contract was purchased or, for a transfer, the date the buyer's contract was issued.

purchase_channel.meaning: How the contract was obtained: on the installation contract, within the post-installation purchase window, on inspected existing equipment, or by transfer from a seller.

equipment_scope.meaning: Whether the contract covers one unit or a matched indoor/outdoor system.

coverage_start.meaning: First day failures are covered; empty while pending.

coverage_end.meaning: Last day failures are covered (inclusive); empty while pending.

contract_price.meaning: Price paid for the contract; 0.00 for the included workmanship warranty and for transferred contracts.

claim_limit_remaining.meaning: Aggregate claim benefit still available over the contract's life; identically the sum of the claim_limit account deltas.

contract_balance.meaning: Amount owed on the contract: positive means the holder owes, negative means Harbison owes the holder; identically the sum of the contract_balance account deltas.

transferred_from_contract_id.meaning: Seller's contract this contract was transferred from (foreign key -> warranty_contracts); empty unless purchase_channel is transfer.

closed_date.meaning: Date the contract expired, transferred out or was cancelled; empty while pending or active.

claim_entry_id.meaning: Primary id of one claim-file, claim-decision, claim-payout or limit-grant entry.

contract_id.meaning: Contract the entry belongs to (foreign key -> warranty_contracts).

event_type.meaning: Event family of the entry, verbatim from the warranty charter.

claim_id.meaning: The claim the entry belongs to: on a claim-file entry it equals that entry's own claim_entry_id; decisions and payouts carry the claim-file entry's id; empty on limit grants.

ticket_id.meaning: Service ticket on which the failure was diagnosed and repaired (foreign key -> service_tickets); empty on limit grants.

equipment_id.meaning: Unit that failed (foreign key -> equipment); empty on limit grants.

component.meaning: Failed component the claim is for; empty on limit grants.

failure_date.meaning: Date the failure was diagnosed by the technician (the service ticket's diagnosis date); empty on limit grants.

entry_date.meaning: Date the entry was posted: filing date, decision date, payout date or grant date.

decision.meaning: Outcome of a claim decision; empty on other entries.

denial_reason.meaning: Governing reason for a denial or for the denied part of a partial approval; empty on approvals and on other entries.

decision_round.format: integer, 1 for the original decision, 2 for an appeal decision
decision_round.meaning: Which decision on the claim this is; 0 on non-decision entries.

payout_component.meaning: What a payout reimburses on the service invoice (or, for unit_replacement, on the replacement installation contract); empty on other entries.

amount.meaning: Approved amount on a decision, paid amount on a payout, or granted limit on a limit grant; 0.00 on claim-file entries and denials.

grant_reason.meaning: Why a claim limit was granted; empty on other entries.

warranty_billing_id.meaning: Primary id of one protection-contract billing entry.

contract_id.meaning: Contract the entry is posted to (foreign key -> warranty_contracts).

event_type.meaning: Event family of the entry, verbatim from the warranty charter.

line_type.meaning: What the entry is: a charge, a payment, a credit, or the payout of a credit balance.

amount.meaning: Entry amount; the direction comes from the event family.

claim_id.meaning: Claim a claim service fee or its waiver belongs to (the claim-file entry id); empty otherwise.

ticket_id.meaning: Service ticket (visit) a claim service fee is charged for (foreign key -> service_tickets); empty otherwise.

payment_method.meaning: How a payment was made or a payout returned; empty on charges and credits.

payment_reference.meaning: Processor confirmation number of a payment or payout; empty on charges and credits.

source_billing_id.meaning: The specific earlier billing entry this entry offsets or pays out (the contract-price charge a cancellation credit refunds, the credit a payout settles); empty when standalone.

warranty_request_id.meaning: Primary id of a holder-confirmed contract change request.

contract_id.meaning: Contract the request concerns (foreign key -> warranty_contracts).

property_sale_date.meaning: Closing date of the home sale as printed on the settlement statement, for transfer requests; empty for cancellations.

buyer_customer_id.meaning: Customer profile of the home buyer receiving a transfer (foreign key -> customers); empty for cancellations.

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

ticket_id.meaning: Primary id of one service call (work order).

customer_id.meaning: Customer the call is for (foreign key -> customers).

equipment_id.meaning: Unit the call is about (foreign key -> equipment); empty when the symptom is not tied to one unit.

variant_name.meaning: Call class the visit is booked under, as the official class name.

status.meaning: Lifecycle state of the call (basis in the service charter lifecycle).

booked_channel.meaning: Channel the call was booked through.

arrival_window.meaning: Promised arrival window on the scheduled date (Eastern local time).

dispatched_at.meaning: Moment a technician was dispatched; empty while booked.

arrived_at.meaning: Moment the technician arrived on site; empty until arrival.

completed_date.meaning: Date the technician completed the work and the invoice was issued; also the diagnosis date for warranty purposes; empty until completed.

closed_date.meaning: Date the invoice was settled to zero; empty until closed.

cancelled_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
cancelled_at.meaning: Moment the call was cancelled; empty unless cancelled.

recall_of_ticket_id.meaning: Earlier ticket whose repair this call returns to under the repair guarantee (foreign key -> service_tickets); empty for an ordinary call.

ticket_balance.meaning: Amount owed on the invoice: positive means the customer owes, negative means Harbison owes the customer; identically the sum of the ticket_balance account deltas.

line_id.meaning: Primary id of one invoice line on a service ticket.

ticket_id.meaning: Ticket the line is on (foreign key -> service_tickets).

event_type.meaning: Event family of the line, verbatim from the service charter.

line_seq.meaning: Position of the line on the invoice, numbered in posting order.

line_type.meaning: What the line is: a charge, a discount, a coverage credit, a payment or a refund.

task_code.meaning: Price-book task the charge line bills; empty on fee lines, payments and refunds; discount and coverage lines leave it empty and point to their charge through source_line_id.

quantity.format: number, up to 1 decimal place (pounds for refrigerant, units otherwise)
quantity.meaning: Quantity billed on a charge line; 1 on fee and task lines; 0 on non-charge lines.

amount.meaning: Line amount; the direction comes from the event family.

source_line_id.meaning: The specific charge line a discount or coverage credit applies to, or the payment line a refund returns; empty on charges and payments.

claim_id.meaning: Warranty claim that pays a warranty coverage line (the claim-file entry id in warranty_claim_entries); empty otherwise.

agreement_id.meaning: Comfort Club agreement whose benefit a member discount or plan coverage line applies (foreign key -> plan_agreements); empty otherwise.

payment_method.meaning: How a payment was made or a refund returned; empty on other lines.

payment_reference.meaning: Processor confirmation or check number of a payment or refund; empty on other lines.

install_id.meaning: Primary id of one replacement-system installation contract.

customer_id.meaning: Homeowner who signed the contract (foreign key -> customers).

values: Harbison Performance Hybrid Heat Pump System
variant_name.meaning: System package contracted, as the official package name.

status.meaning: Lifecycle state of the project (basis in the install charter lifecycle).

signed_date.meaning: Date the homeowner signed the installation contract; day 0 of the cancellation period.

municipality.meaning: Permitting jurisdiction of the service address.

nominal_tons.meaning: Cooling capacity of the system contracted.

contract_price.meaning: Package price written on the signed contract before change orders, fees and credits.

project_balance.meaning: Amount owed on the project: positive means the homeowner owes, negative means Harbison owes the homeowner; identically the sum of the project_balance account deltas.

replaced_equipment_id.meaning: Existing unit being replaced (foreign key -> equipment); empty for new construction additions.

finance_account_id.meaning: Financing account funding the project (foreign key -> finance_accounts); empty when not financed.

scheduled_date.meaning: Installation day booked; empty until scheduled.

permit_number.meaning: Mechanical permit number issued by the municipality; empty until pulled.

installed_date.meaning: Date the crew completed installation and started up the system; empty until installed.

new_equipment_serial.meaning: Serial number of the new outdoor unit (or of the furnace for heating-only scopes); empty until installed.

inspected_date.meaning: Date the municipal inspection passed; empty until inspected.

closed_date.meaning: Date the project was closed out; empty until closed.

cancelled_date.meaning: Date the cancellation took effect; empty unless cancelled.

install_entry_id.meaning: Primary id of one installation ledger entry.

install_id.meaning: Project the entry is posted to (foreign key -> install_projects).

event_type.meaning: Event family of the entry, verbatim from the install charter.

change_order_no.meaning: Sequence number of the signed change order a change-order charge bills.

accessory_code.meaning: Accessory an accessory charge or accessory discount concerns; empty otherwise.

upgrade_variant_name.meaning: Protection tier bought on a labor-warranty-upgrade charge; empty otherwise.

amount.meaning: Entry amount; the direction comes from the event family; 0.00 on registration entries.

posted_date.meaning: Date the entry was posted; for a registration, the date the registration was submitted to the manufacturer.

payment_method.meaning: How a payment was made or a refund returned; empty on charges, credits and registrations.

payment_reference.meaning: Processor confirmation, check number or lender funding reference of a payment or refund; empty otherwise.

finance_account_id.meaning: Financing account a disbursement came from or a refund returns to (foreign key -> finance_accounts); empty otherwise.

source_entry_id.meaning: The specific earlier entry this entry offsets or returns (the payment a refund returns, the charge a credit reduces); empty when standalone.

claim_id.meaning: Protection contract claim (claim-file entry id in warranty_claim_entries) whose unit-replacement payout a warranty unit replacement credit carries; empty otherwise.

equipment_serial.meaning: Serial number registered with the manufacturer, on registration entries; empty otherwise.

registered_parts_years.meaning: Manufacturer parts warranty term confirmed by the registration; 0 on other entries.

install_request_id.meaning: Primary id of a homeowner-confirmed project change request.

install_id.meaning: Project the request concerns (foreign key -> install_projects).

request_type.meaning: What the homeowner asked for or must approve.

change_order_no.format: integer >= 1 for change orders; 0 for cancellations
change_order_no.meaning: Change order the approval is for.

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
created_at.meaning: Moment the homeowner's request or notice was received; for cancellations, the notice date.

finance_account_id.meaning: Primary id of one Home Comfort Financing account.

install_id.meaning: Installation project the account finances (foreign key -> install_projects).

variant_name.meaning: Financing plan, as the official plan name.

status.meaning: Lifecycle state of the account (basis in the finance charter lifecycle).

application_date.meaning: Date the credit application was submitted.

decision_date.meaning: Date of the credit decision; empty while applied.

credit_tier.meaning: Credit tier assigned by the credit decision (tier_1 strongest); empty while applied or when declined.

amount_requested.meaning: Amount the borrower applied to finance.

amount_financed.meaning: Approved amount, and once funded the amount actually disbursed; 0.00 while applied or when declined.

apr_pct.meaning: Contract APR in effect for the plan after any autopay reduction.

funded_date.meaning: Date the loan funded to Harbison; empty until active.

promo_end_date.meaning: Last day of a promotional period; empty for fixed-rate plans.

monthly_payment.meaning: Required monthly payment set at funding.

payment_due_day.meaning: Day of each month the payment is due.

autopay_enrolled.meaning: Whether monthly payments are drafted automatically.

account_balance.meaning: Amount owed on the account including posted interest and fees; identically the sum of the loan_balance account deltas.

closed_date.meaning: Date the account reached paid_off, charged_off, withdrawn, expired or declined; empty otherwise.

finance_txn_id.meaning: Primary id of one financing transaction.

finance_account_id.meaning: Account the transaction posts to (foreign key -> finance_accounts).

event_type.meaning: Event family of the transaction, verbatim from the finance charter.

statement_period.meaning: Statement month the transaction belongs to.

amount.meaning: Transaction amount; the direction comes from the event family.

install_id.meaning: Installation project a disbursement funds or a merchant refund comes from (foreign key -> install_projects); empty otherwise.

install_entry_id.meaning: The installation refund entry a merchant refund credit passes through (foreign key -> install_ledger); empty otherwise.

payment_method.meaning: How a payment was made; empty on other transactions.

payment_reference.meaning: Confirmation number of a payment; empty on other transactions.

source_txn_id.meaning: The specific transaction this one refers to: the charge a reversal reverses, the payment a returned-payment entry or returned-payment fee concerns (foreign key -> finance_transactions); empty otherwise.

finance_request_id.meaning: Primary id of a borrower-confirmed financing request.

finance_account_id.meaning: Account the request concerns (foreign key -> finance_accounts).

target_variant_name.meaning: Plan requested in a plan change before funding; empty otherwise.

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

subscription_id.meaning: Primary id of one FilterDirect filter subscription.

variant_name.meaning: Subscription grade, as the official name.

status.meaning: Lifecycle state of the subscription (basis in the filter charter lifecycle).

started_date.meaning: Date the subscription was signed up.

next_ship_date.meaning: Date the next shipment is scheduled to leave the warehouse; empty while paused or cancelled.

paused_until.meaning: Date a pause ends; empty unless paused.

subscription_balance.meaning: Amount owed: positive means the subscriber owes; identically the sum of the subscription_balance account deltas.

cancelled_date.meaning: Date the subscription was cancelled; empty otherwise.

filter_entry_id.meaning: Primary id of one subscription ledger or shipment entry.

event_type.meaning: Event family of the entry, verbatim from the filter charter.

ship_cycle.meaning: Shipment cycle (month the shipment leaves) the entry belongs to.

filters_shipped.meaning: Number of filters in a shipment; 0 on money entries.

posted_date.meaning: Date the entry posted (ship date for shipments).

payment_reference.meaning: Processor confirmation of a payment; empty otherwise.

source_entry_id.meaning: The specific shipment or charge a credit concerns; empty otherwise.

lease_id.meaning: Primary id of one ComfortLease equipment lease.

variant_name.meaning: Leased system, as the official lease name.

status.meaning: Lifecycle state of the lease (basis in the lease charter lifecycle).

equipment_id.meaning: Leased equipment (foreign key -> equipment); empty until installed.

installed_date.meaning: Date the leased equipment was installed and rent began; empty until installed.

monthly_rent.meaning: Current monthly rent including applied anniversary increases.

lease_balance.meaning: Amount owed on the lease; identically the sum of the lease_balance account deltas.

end_date.meaning: Date the lease ended by buyout or termination; empty otherwise.

lease_entry_id.meaning: Primary id of one lease ledger entry.

event_type.meaning: Event family of the entry, verbatim from the lease charter.

rent_period.meaning: Rent month the entry belongs to.

amount.meaning: Entry amount; the direction comes from the event family.

payment_reference.meaning: Processor confirmation of a payment; empty otherwise.

source_entry_id.meaning: The specific charge a credit offsets; empty otherwise.

lease_request_id.meaning: Primary id of a lessee-confirmed lease change request.

lease_id.meaning: Lease the request concerns (foreign key -> lease_agreements).

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

verification_id.meaning: Primary id of the identity-verification record for one customer.

verified_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
verified_at.meaning: Moment of the most recent verification attempt.

handoff_id.meaning: Primary id of a transfer to a human representative.

reason.meaning: Reason for the handoff; closed set of exactly these two values.

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
